recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-17255 unless Pharmacy later reopens the course-of-therapy value set contents or binding strength.
issue_request: FHIR-17255 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy change request raised against STU3 MedicationPrescription/MedicationRequest. It requested a long-term medication indicator by adding a 0..1 course-of-therapy attribute with values for continuous long-term therapy, short-course acute therapy, and seasonal therapy, plus a warning not to confuse the attribute with medication protocol.
initial_application: Jira records the issue as applied on 2018-07-25. Git commit ce698b9ee5288dac0d1f13735b92bb16a46c008d explicitly included GF 17255 and added MedicationRequest.courseOfTherapyType to the then-authoritative spreadsheet; commit 7373e742ee4ae5907dc0d8b0779cadb0cb0892f0 added the course-of-therapy CodeSystem and ValueSet files.
additional_context: MedicationRequest is active in source/fhir.ini, and fhir.ini records MedicationPrescription as having become MedicationRequest. FHIR-20181 later corrected the introduced definition typo and is already audited on the combined branch. FHIR-32489 later resolved that this same binding should be extensible, confirmed by Pharmacy minutes and already audited on the combined branch, so the current extensible binding should not be reverted to the original example binding.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the current build-scope MedicationRequest StructureDefinition and ValueSet source already satisfy the seed request when later binding-strength context is considered.

related_jiras.note: Corrected the 'patte3rn' typo in the definition introduced by FHIR-17255 and is already represented on the combined branch by commit 33a5ace3b717dbc21792d1cbf03a5956bea07bea.

Supersedes the original example binding by resolving that MedicationRequest.courseOfTherapyType should be extensible and is already represented on the combined branch by commit 669e0900b013a803f2a6ef75ba1705bf898d96e6.
